name: ceo-inbox-download-attachment
description: Download an email attachment from the principal's personal inbox. Prefer passing filename (short, readable) from ceo-inbox-read's attachments array — Nylas attachment IDs are long opaque strings that are easy to mistype. attachment_id still works for an exact match. Returns the file content ready to pass to file-parse: when temporary-file storage succeeds the output provides a temporary file reference (temp_file_url) instead of content_base64; otherwise it returns base64-encoded content_base64. Enforces a 10 MB size limit.

inputs.attachment_id: string? (Nylas attachment ID from ceo-inbox-read's attachments array — optional when filename is provided; long IDs are often mistyped, so prefer filename)
inputs.filename: string? (exact attachment filename from ceo-inbox-read — preferred over attachment_id; must be unique on the message)
inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID the attachment belongs to)

outputs.temp_file_url: string | undefined (file:// URL of the downloaded bytes on disk — for binary-safe Drive uploads, pass this as create_drive_file's fileUrl param and use the `filename` field as the file_name param to preserve the original attachment name)
outputs.content_base64: string | undefined (base64-encoded file content — only included when temp_file_url is unavailable, to avoid exceeding the skill output size limit)
